proposed_architecture.nuisances: Retain correlated plausible parameter combinations. Use conditional linear structure for computation; do not freeze values at scoring truth or delete weak directions. Any later reduction must pass future-response and closed-loop correction tests over declared inputs.
proposed_architecture.physical_exponentials: Retain exp(-dt/tau) RC relaxation and the existing physically assumed hysteresis response. The rejected exponential is arbitrary likelihood discounting, not the physical solution of the model's differential equations.
proposed_architecture.aging: Past observations constrain past health. Advance their current implications through an explicit transition on effective Q/R0 using elapsed time and throughput; preserve correlations and the charge ledger. Separate predicted drift, measurement correction, and uncertainty from unobserved evolution. Calibration and model-form errors cannot be hidden by increasing diffusion.
proposed_architecture.health_time_resolution: Do not silently replace the currently specified per-record truncated transition by sparse knots. A coarser health representation is a proposed model/numerical approximation requiring an error and boundary analysis; slow typical aging alone does not establish equivalence.
proposed_architecture.uncertainty_and_semantics: Fast point optimization can resume without promising a full marginal posterior. Profile elimination, local curvature and marginalization must remain distinct. Proposed point-first development is an explicit scope amendment to the previous full-posterior requirement, not an already implemented semantic change. Certified/calibrated uncertainty remains unresolved until separately qualified. Retain the existing joint prior and modes; approximate Gaussian summaries require their own validation.
